claims.claim: On October 20, Utah Attorney General Derek Brown sued five Kalshi entities and two Susquehanna firms in state court, seeking injunctions, restitution, and geolocation-based access limits, and filing the suit does not itself impose those limits.
claims.episode_span: On October 20, Utah Attorney General Derek Brown sued five Kalshi entities and two Susquehanna firms
claims.source_title: Utah Sues Kalshi, Seeks Court Order Blocking Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: Utah sued prediction market operator Kalshi on Oct. 20, asking a court to block sports and other event contracts in the state because it says the markets violate its gambling laws.

claims.claim: The civil complaint names five Kalshi entities and two Susquehanna entities and seeks restrictions on sports, election, politics, culture and mentions contracts through a court-approved geolocation provider; filing does not itself impose those restrictions.
claims.episode_span: seeking preliminary and permanent injunctions on sports, election, politics, culture and mentions contracts
claims.source_title: Utah Sues Kalshi, Seeks Court Order Blocking Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: The civil complaint seeks restrictions on sports, election, politics, culture and “mentions” contracts, with access controlled through a court-approved geolocation provider. It names five Kalshi entities and two Susquehanna entities.

claims.claim: Attorney General Derek Brown said Kalshi’s event contracts are indistinguishable from sports bets, and Utah residents have lost between 36 million and 66 million dollars through Kalshi since February, with almost 33,000 accounts in the state.
claims.episode_span: residents have lost between 36 million and 66 million dollars through Kalshi since February
claims.source_title: Utah sues Kalshi over prediction market operations
claims.supporting_quote: Attorney General Derek Brown said, as reported by Fox13 Now , that Utah residents have lost between US$36m and $66m through Kalshi since February.

claims.claim: Utah estimates fees tied to Utah accounts at 30,591,600 to 61,183,200 dollars as of October 19, an extrapolation, and Kalshi listed 32,940 fully signed-up accounts with Utah addresses as of February 25.
claims.episode_span: a separate fee estimate of 30,591,600 to 61,183,200 dollars as of October 19
claims.source_title: Utah Sues Kalshi, Seeks Court Order Blocking Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: The state estimates fees tied to contracts placed through Utah accounts at $30,591,600 to $61,183,200 as of Oct. 19. That range is an extrapolation, and the actual amount may differ.

claims.claim: Utah alleges Susquehanna International Group and Susquehanna Government Products act as market makers taking the other side of retail trades, and the claims are not yet verified.
claims.episode_span: Susquehanna International Group and Susquehanna Government Products act as market makers
claims.source_title: Utah sues Kalshi and Susquehanna as prediction-market scrutiny widens
claims.supporting_quote: The lawsuit also involves Susquehanna International Group and Susquehanna Government Products. The state of Utah contends that the companies function as market makers and take the opposite position on trades initiated by retail consumers.

claims.claim: Kalshi spokesperson Jacki McGavick said Kalshi is a federally regulated financial exchange overseen by the CFTC, that customers trade with each other and set prices, and that the Utah state-court action does not affect ongoing federal litigation.
claims.episode_span: Kalshi spokesperson Jacki McGavick told Cointelegraph that Kalshi is a federally regulated financial exchange
claims.source_title: Utah AG sues Kalshi, pursues profits from prediction market company
claims.supporting_quote: “Kalshi is a federally regulated financial exchange, like the stock market,“ Kalshi spokesperson Jacki McGavick told Cointelegraph in response to the Utah lawsuit.

claims.claim: An August 4 federal ruling found commodities law did not bar Utah from applying its gambling laws to Kalshi’s sports contracts, and on September 8 an appeals court rejected Kalshi’s bid for interim relief.
claims.episode_span: An August 4 federal ruling found commodities law did not bar Utah from applying its gambling laws
claims.source_title: Utah Sues Kalshi, Seeks Court Order Blocking Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: In a separate case, an Aug. 4 federal ruling found that commodities law did not bar Utah from applying its gambling laws to Kalshi’s sports contracts. Kalshi appealed, but on Sept. 8 the appeals court rejected its bid for interim relief.

claims.claim: Vlad Tenev said Robinhood’s prediction-markets unit traded roughly 2.5 billion event contracts in October, more than all of the third quarter combined.
claims.episode_span: Robinhood’s prediction-markets unit traded roughly 2.5 billion event contracts in October
claims.source_title: Robinhood's prediction markets business is now outgrowing crypto trading
claims.supporting_quote: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev said this week that the company's prediction markets unit traded roughly 2.5 billion event contracts in October, more volume than all of the third quarter combined.

claims.claim: At a penny per contract, Yahoo Finance put October fees at about 25 million dollars, implying about 300 million dollars in annualized revenue, double the prior quarter run rate.
claims.episode_span: Yahoo Finance put October fees at about 25 million dollars
claims.source_title: Robinhood's prediction markets business is now outgrowing crypto trading
claims.supporting_quote: At a penny per contract, that's about $25 million in fees from October alone, according to Yahoo Finance. That puts the unit on pace for roughly $300 million in annualized revenue, double the run rate from the prior quarter.

claims.claim: Rothera, a CFTC-licensed exchange Robinhood built with Susquehanna, has processed more than 3.5 billion contracts since late May, with FIFA World Cup markets about 93 percent of that volume.
claims.episode_span: Rothera, a CFTC-licensed exchange built with Susquehanna that has processed more than 3.5 billion contracts since late May
claims.source_title: Robinhood's prediction markets business is now outgrowing crypto trading
claims.supporting_quote: Rothera has processed more than 3.5 billion contracts since launching in late May, with FIFA World Cup markets driving about 93% of that volume.

claims.claim: Kalshi posted a record 19.03 billion dollars in weekly contract volume for the week of October 5 to 11.
claims.episode_span: Kalshi posted a record 19.03 billion dollars in weekly contract volume for October 5 to 11
claims.source_title: Robinhood's prediction markets business is now outgrowing crypto trading
claims.supporting_quote: Kalshi posted a record $19.03 billion in weekly contract volume for the week of October 5 to 11, its highest weekly total yet

claims.claim: Blockchain.com last week applied for a US licence to offer regulated prediction markets, and Binance US has sought approval, joining Coinbase, Crypto.com and Gemini.
claims.episode_span: Blockchain.com last week applied for a US licence to offer regulated prediction markets
claims.source_title: Crypto exchanges target prediction markets as token trading declines
claims.supporting_quote: Blockchain.com last week applied for a US licence to offer regulated prediction markets, while Binance US has also recently sought regulatory approval, joining Coinbase, Crypto.com and Gemini in targeting the rapidly growing sector.

claims.claim: Trading volumes on Polymarket and Kalshi rose more than 300 percent from 17 billion dollars in January to 72 billion dollars in September, while spot crypto trading volumes fell 18 percent.
claims.episode_span: trading volume on Polymarket and Kalshi up more than 300 percent, from 17 billion dollars in January to 72 billion dollars in September
claims.source_title: Crypto exchanges target prediction markets as token trading declines
claims.supporting_quote: Trading volumes on Polymarket and Kalshi surged more than 300% from $17bn in January to $72bn in September, according to data from The Block. Spot crypto trading volumes declined 18% over the same period.

claims.claim: Michigan regulators said this month that Coinbase had agreed to stop offering event contracts to customers in the state.
claims.episode_span: Coinbase had agreed to stop offering event contracts to customers in the state
claims.source_title: Crypto exchanges target prediction markets as token trading declines
claims.supporting_quote: Michigan regulators said this month that Coinbase had agreed to stop offering event contracts to customers in the state.

claims.claim: CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig said super intelligence is poised to transform financial markets, and the Innovation Task Force released the agenda for the inaugural Frontier Forum on Super Intelligence.
claims.episode_span: Chairman Michael S. Selig said super intelligence is poised to transform US financial markets
claims.source_title: CFTC’s Innovation Task Force Announces Agenda & Panelists for Inaugural Frontier Forum on Super Intelligence
claims.supporting_quote: “Super intelligence is poised to transform our financial markets,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig.

claims.claim: A Brennan Center analysis of 1,994 registered voters fielded September 21 and released October 20 found respondents 10 to 20 percentage points more likely to say a candidate would win when Kalshi gave that candidate better odds, regardless of polls.
claims.episode_span: respondents were 10 percentage points more likely to name that candidate the winner
claims.source_title: Brennan Center Study: Kalshi Odds Sway Voters' Picks
claims.supporting_quote: The survey of 1,994 self-identified registered voters, fielded Sept. 21, found respondents were 10 to 20 percentage points more likely to say a candidate would win when Kalshi gave that candidate better odds, no matter what the polls said.

claims.claim: A candidate at 67 percent on Kalshi was 10 points more likely to be picked than one at 50 percent, and a candidate at 84 percent saw a 20-point gain; 33 percent odds cut picks by 11 points and 16 percent by 19 points.
claims.episode_span: Move that displayed figure to 67 percent and respondents were 10 percentage points more likely
claims.source_title: Brennan Center Study: Kalshi Odds Sway Voters' Picks
claims.supporting_quote: A candidate given 67% odds on Kalshi was 10 percentage points more likely to be picked as the winner than one at 50%, and a candidate at 84% saw a 20-point gain.

claims.claim: Only 19 percent of respondents said election prediction markets are accurate, compared with 37 percent for traditional polls, and a caution about prediction markets had no effect.
claims.episode_span: Only 19 percent of respondents said election prediction markets are accurate
claims.source_title: Brennan Center Study: Kalshi Odds Sway Voters' Picks
claims.supporting_quote: Only 19% of respondents said election prediction markets are accurate, roughly half the 37% who said the same of traditional polls.

claims.claim: On Kalshi, read 2026-10-21 10:07 UTC, the Democratic Party was at a 90.7 percent implied probability to win the US House, with 1.6 million contracts of 24-hour volume.
claims.episode_span: Democratic Party at a 90.7 percent implied probability; Kalshi; 1.6 million contracts
claims.source_title: Which party will win the U.S. House?
claims.supporting_quote: Democratic Party: 90.7% implied probability

claims.episode_span: Flávio Bolsonaro at an 80 percent implied probability, up 3.2 points in 24 hours

claims.supporting_quote: Flávio Bolsonaro: 80% implied probability (+3.2 points in 24 hours)

claims.episode_span: Polymarket listed a market asking whether Laurent Nuñez is out as France’s interior minister
claims.source_title: NEW POLYMARKET: Nuñez out as French Interior Minister by...?
claims.supporting_quote: Nuñez publicly offered his resignation, citing responsibility and shortcomings in planning and intelligence, but President Emmanuel Macron rejected it on October 19
